# Shirdi Sai Marbles & Tiles

> Premier marble, granite, and vitrified tiles showroom and wholesale distributor located in Jajpur Town, Odisha. Serving homeowners, builders, and architects across Odisha since 2010 with 16 years of business excellence.

## Official Showroom & Products
- [Showroom & Product Collections](https://shirdi-sai-marbles.vercel.app/#products): Premium floor tiles (600x1200mm, 800x1600mm), 3D wall tiles, double charge vitrified tiles, imported Italian marble, Statuario marble, and heavy-duty kitchen granite slabs.
- [Tile & Square Feet Estimator](https://shirdi-sai-marbles.vercel.app/#calculator): Interactive room calculator to instantly compute total square feet and required box counts with 10% wastage margin.
- [Design Inspiration Gallery](https://shirdi-sai-marbles.vercel.app/#gallery): Curated room ideas for living rooms, master bedrooms, modern kitchens, luxury bathrooms, and exterior elevations.
- [Why Choose Us](https://shirdi-sai-marbles.vercel.app/#why-us): 16 years in business, 500+ live stock designs, direct factory wholesale pricing, fast doorstep delivery across Odisha.
- [Showroom Visit & Hours](https://shirdi-sai-marbles.vercel.app/#visit): Located at Raniramchandrapur, Gariapur, Jajpur Town, Odisha - 755001. Open 7 days a week (Mon-Sat 9AM-8PM, Sun 9AM-7PM).
- [Request Price Estimate](https://shirdi-sai-marbles.vercel.app/#contact): Instant WhatsApp quotations, catalog downloads, and wholesale project consultations.
